t: This is a bust of George Basevi, made by the sculptor Jonathan Wylder. Basevi was an architect, a pupil of Sir John Soane, who worked in both Neoclassical and Gothic Revival styles. He designed Belgrave Square here in London, and the Fitzwilliam Museum in Cambridge. He was also surveyor to the Thurloe estate, which is part of why his name is tied to this part of town. It's a fitting portrait of a man who shaped so much of the city's streets.
